Frik du Preez turns 85

By: ALTYDVRYSTAAT PRODUCTIONS | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Rugby legend Frik du Preez turns 85

Unique Selling Point:
We film messages for Friks birthday from all around the world. We want to visit him and take him video messages from his 10 favorite friends/heroes and celebrate with him despite of COVID19 and him not having a big party to celebrate.
Frik watches the messages with a camera team there to capture his reaction.


Summary:
Rugby legend Frik du Preez turns 85 on the 28th November. Du Preez made his test debut for the Springboks on 7 January 1961 in the flank position against England at Twickenham. In the 1969 Currie Cup final legendary lock, Oom Frik du Preez, managed to score in every manner the game makes available when he kicked a penalty and a drop goal, before scoring a try and converting it!

With this insert we will film birthday messages from rugby and sports stars as well as celebrities that all wish oom Frik a happy 85th birthday, as he will not be able to have a birthday party due to Covid.

We ask each person two questions.

1) They wish him happy birthday
2) They get to ask Frik a question that thy have always wanted to know or tell him sonething they always wanted to...

Some of the people live abroad and will send cellphone videos.

We edit a short clip with the birthday messages and surprise Frik with it. We film his reaction and get him to answer the questions.

If possible we would like to take a guest presenter with like Schalk Brits or Jean de Villiers when filming Frik’s reaction.


Further information:
Birthday messages from some of the below names:

1. Willy John McBride
2. Gareth Edwards
3. Tommy Bedford

Script:


FRIK DU PREEZ _ MASTER
LINK According to the history books the first official rugby match in SA was played at Greenpoint in 1862... and the bug bit... one of the legends of SA rugby is turning 85 this month and has stories to tell about his illustrious career...

V/O Frik du Preez... a name that made opponents tremble in their boots, and had supporters jumping to their feet in delirious joy. This Springbok legend, who in his time dropped, placed and scored, turned 85 yesterday.
Upsound
V/O Physical distancing and the Coronavirus meant Du Preez could not celebrate this significant birthday with a mass event. In cahoots with his wife of 39 years, Bes, we made a list of the people Frik respects and gathered their well wishes from around the globe.
On a sunny summer day, we arrived unannounced on his Bushveld farm bearing gifts.
Willie John McBride Hello Frik, well-done on reaching the 85th number. I didn’t realise you were a lot older than me because I’m a young fella still. I’m only 80 now.
V/O In the pre-isolation times of no World Cups, and with very few international test matches, Du Preez, together with the flanker Jan Ellis, held the record for most matches played for South Africa. This record of 36 games was only broken after the Springboks returned to international rugby in 1992.
Frik du Preez Mac: Oom, where did it all start for you? When we grew up we heard the saying that a boerseun was born with a rugby ball in his hand… Was that the case with you?
Frik: Ek het in die bosveld grootgeword, ons het nie rugby geken nie, jy weet. Toe ek nou in die hoërskool kom het ek nou bietjie gespeel. Maar my eintlike rugby toe ek in die lugmag gekom het in 1953.
V/O In 1956 Du Preez outjumped, outpunched and outmuscled the grizzled Springbok lock Salty du Randt, and rugby supporters took notice for the first time. Two years later Du Preez was selected for Northern Transvaal, but greater glory was still to come.
LINK On the 7th of January 1961, at the age of 25, and with stars in his eyes, Du Preez ran onto Twickenham as part of the Springbok team – a match they won 5-0 – a legend was born...

Frik du Preez My grootste hoogtepunt is toe hulle my kies vir die Springbok toerspan. Ek het daai jaar nie vir Noord-Transvaal gespeel nie.

Mac: Kon jy dit glo?

Nee.
V/O The importance of fitting into a team’s culture is one thing that hasn’t changed in rugby. Du Preez remembers a past coach’s pearls of wisdom from the early stages of his career.
Frik Du Preez Toe sê hy vir my, jy gaan op ‘n vier maande toer, ons het 34 wedstryde gespeel op daai toer. Hy sê die voordeel is as jy swak speel gaan hulle jou nie huis toe stuur nie. Hulle gaan jou weer speel. Jy moet net in die span aanpas en dan sal dinge self gebeur. En dit was die beste raad wat ek in my lewe gekry het.
V/O Tommy Bedford joined the Springbok squad a few years later, and recalls the games with Du Preez fondly.
Tommy Bedford Ou Frikkie, we as players certainly had great respect for you. You were a wonderful player and you’re a lovely man.
V/O Du Preez made a lasting impression on a young Wynand Claassen, who years later, led the Springboks to New Zealand in 1981.
Wynand Claassen As ‘n skool laaitie was Frik een van my groot helde en almal het hom probeer na-aap… Frik het altyd met die bal in een hand gehardloop en ek het dit ook begin doen. Tot eendag die onderwyser my uittrap, toe sê ek maar Meneer, Frik doen dit. Toe sê hy maar jy’s nie Frik du Preez nie.
V/O The Welshman Gareth Edwards, himself voted the greatest rugby player of all time, in a 2003 poll conducted by Rugby World magazine, remembers the daunting first sight of Du Preez.
Gareth Edwards I’ll never forget that first time that I set eyes on you - or at least I thought I had. The first test in Pretoria, 1968, my first experience of British Lions Touring and that first test up at Loftus Versfeld… I’ll never forget it.
V/O Refusing to be type-cast as a brute strength forward, in a magnificent display of speed and elegance, du Preez scored his only international try against the 1968 British Lions in Pretoria.
UPSOUND GAME
Gareth Edwards I had great pride in my sprinting prowess of those days and you whizzed past me and everybody else in the front of the lineout, but I turned and I thought it’s 25 yards I’ll still get him. Anyway, you swerved and I never ever set a hand on you.
Frik du Preez I remember the whole movement.We practiced it about… more than 50 times, and we practiced it more than 50 times later. It only worked that day. Once.

Mac: Wow

You know, if I watch the film I think the British Lions were surprised but the guy most surprised was me.

V/O In 1969 the one man show, named Frik du Preez, made history in the Currie Cup Final.
Frik du Preez Mac: They call it a drop, a place and a score… Do you remember that day?
Ja, slightly… I remember it ja.
UPSOUND GAME
V/O Du Preez scored in every possible manner that is available in the game of rugby…(UPSOUND)

… helping to secure another Currie Cup win for Northern Transvaal.
V/O After retiring from the sport in 1971 he met the love of his life...
Bes du Preez MAC: You must have been the envy of all the girls, because I mean this is Rugby legend…

Nee wat, ag ek dink nie so nie. Hy was toe ook al ouer. Hy was 46 toe ons getroud is.
Frik du Preez Ek het al amper moed opgegee, ek het gedog ek gaan nie meer ‘n vrou kry nie...Maar nou ja, dis een van die beste dinge wat met my gebeur het, sjoe! Maar ek is vies vir haar want sy het my nie gesê van die verassing vanoggend nie.
Bes du Preez Hy’t ‘n verskriklike goeie sin vir humor. En hy het my van die begin af laat lag, en sy stories… ek het al van sy stories honderd keer gehoor maar elke keer lag ek weer!
V/O In his lifetime Du Preez met many famous people but for him one name stands out.
Frik du Preez Mac: Oom het vir Nelson Mandela ontmoet… How was that for you? What did you say to each other.

Ek sal nooit vergeet nie en hy sê I want to thank you for what you’ve done for South African rugby. Toe besef ek hy’s ‘n rugby-ou, jy weet. En hy sê vir my But I believe you love Brussel Sprouts!...
V/O Du Preez’s “special relationship” with brussel sprouts started at a dinner in Wales during his first Springbok Tour to the UK in 1961.
Frik du Preez En hulle bring die kos… en daar in die bord is brussel sprouts. Ken jy brussel sprouts?

Mac: ja ja

Maar ek het hom in lewe nog nooit gesien nie. En Fanie Keen, my pal wat voorry speel sit oorkant my, maar sy Engels is slegter as myne. Hy sê vir my Frik, what is this? Ek sê ask the guy next to you… Hy sê what is this… Hy sê this is a brussel sprout, don’t you get it in South Africa? Hy sê yes in South Africa it grows this size, we call it cabbage.
Toe ons in 69 gaan toer het toe is dit weer brussel sprouts toe seê ek vir Dawie de Villiers, Jissus ek wil brussel sprouts gaan plant by die huis… en as hulle opkom wil ek my army boots aantrek en hulle in hul moer intrap en skop… hy sê vir my… and I believe you are very fond of brussel sprouts. Ek sê vir hom Nee Meneer. Who told you that? Hy sê I have got my contacts.
LINK: In 2000 Frik du Preez was voted as the SA rugby player of the 20th century – an honour that still moves him today… but he humbly says it was a team effort.
Frik du Preez Ek dink dis verkeerd om in ‘n span een ou uit te sonder. Gholf en boks is iets anders, maar in rugby

Mac: Is ‘n hele span.

Ek sou baie meer windgat gewees het as ek in die span van die eeu gewees het.
UPSOUND GAME
Boland Ek dink die grootste kompliment het altyd van dok Craven gekom. En hy het die volgende gesê: i doubt whether we will again see a Frik du Preez. Or the like of Frik du Preez because he was a forward and a back rolled in one.
AB de Villiers He just had this remarkable ability to break a game open, to score a try out of no-where.
John Smith We’ve got huge respect for you and what you’ve done… a servant of the game… you’ve had an amazing influence on those around you when you played and on those that played after you as well..
Frik du Preez Last Birthday


PROMO 1
Remembered for storming runs with the ball in one hand and dropping, placing and scoring in a Currie Cup final, Frik du Preez turned 85 yesterday.
PROMO 2 We celebrate the birthday of South African rugby icon Frik Du Preez, with messages from his wide circle of famous friends and fans.
PROMO 3 We pay tribute to South African rugby player of the 20th century, Frik du Preez, in celebration of his 85th birthday.

Ek sal nooit vergeet nie en hy sê I want to thank you for what you’ve done for South African rugby. Toe besef ek hy’s ‘n rugby-ou, jy weet. En hy sê vir my But I believe you love Brussel Sprouts!... V/O Du Preez’s “special relationship” with brussel sprouts started at a dinner in Wales during his first Springbok Tour to the UK in 1961. Frik du Preez En hulle bring die kos… en daar in die bord is brussel sprouts. Ken jy brussel sprouts? Mac: ja ja Maar ek het hom in lewe nog nooit gesien nie. En Fanie Keen, my pal wat voorry speel sit oorkant my, maar sy Engels is slegter as myne. Hy sê vir my Frik, what is this? Ek sê ask the guy next to you… Hy sê what is this… Hy sê this is a brussel sprout, don’t you get it in South Africa? Hy sê yes in South Africa it grows this size, we call it cabbage. Toe ons in 69 gaan toer het toe is dit weer brussel sprouts toe seê ek vir Dawie de Villiers, Jissus ek wil brussel sprouts gaan plant by die huis… en as hulle opkom wil ek my army boots aantrek en hulle in hul moer intrap en skop… hy sê vir my… and I believe you are very fond of brussel sprouts. Ek sê vir hom Nee Meneer. Who told you that? Hy sê I have got my contacts. LINK: In 2000 Frik du Preez was voted as the SA rugby player of the 20th century – an honour that still moves him today… but he humbly says it was a team effort. Frik du Preez Ek dink dis verkeerd om in ‘n span een ou uit te sonder. Gholf en boks is iets anders, maar in rugby Mac: Is ‘n hele span. Ek sou baie meer windgat gewees het as ek in die span van die eeu gewees het. UPSOUND GAME Boland Ek dink die grootste kompliment het altyd van dok Craven gekom. En hy het die volgende gesê: i doubt whether we will again see a Frik du Preez. Or the like of Frik du Preez because he was a forward and a back rolled in one. AB de Villiers He just had this remarkable ability to break a game open, to score a try out of no-where. John Smith We’ve got huge respect for you and what you’ve done… a servant of the game… you’ve had an amazing influence on those around you when you played and on those that played after you as well.. metadata.Unique Selling Point: We film messages for Friks birthday from all around the world. We want to visit him and take him video messages from his 10 favorite friends/heroes and celebrate with him despite of COVID19 and him not having a big party to celebrate. Frik watches the messages with a camera team there to capture his reaction.
metadata.Summary: Rugby legend Frik du Preez turns 85 on the 28th November. Du Preez made his test debut for the Springboks on 7 January 1961 in the flank position against England at Twickenham. In the 1969 Currie Cup final legendary lock, Oom Frik du Preez, managed to score in every manner the game makes available when he kicked a penalty and a drop goal, before scoring a try and converting it! With this insert we will film birthday messages from rugby and sports stars as well as celebrities that all wish oom Frik a happy 85th birthday, as he will not be able to have a birthday party due to Covid. We ask each person two questions. 1) They wish him happy birthday 2) They get to ask Frik a question that thy have always wanted to know or tell him sonething they always wanted to... Some of the people live abroad and will send cellphone videos. We edit a short clip with the birthday messages and surprise Frik with it. We film his reaction and get him to answer the questions. If possible we would like to take a guest presenter with like Schalk Brits or Jean de Villiers when filming Frik’s reaction.
